flowContract.raceHistory: Only actual canonical race-family draws consume history. Character reference/subtype/power imports do not become extra race draws.
flowContract.fixedGrantRule: Package grants no additional acquisition spin; no fake result/reaction for fixed powers, weapons or bonuses.
flowContract.ownership: Early weapons/powers remain owned even when later main acquisition is None.
flowContract.mastery: Per-owned-weapon immutable base plus exact matching modifiers without numeric clamps then compatible effective Master+ Enchant. One shared Power Mastery for every owned power, including future powers; no Power Enchant.
flowContract.replay: Restore committed result, source grants and saved continuation; no reroll or double application.
flowContract.lateCall: Keep normal existing late-grant/mastery rules and return to exact caller; never advance main stages early.

probabilitySummary.scope: Base odds conditioned on selecting Reinkarnasi Pahlawan Legendaris, before any separately approved character eligibility rules. Main race odds are separate.

contextContract.stack: Actual origin -> character/version -> owned package -> caller facts -> later committed results.
contextContract.futurePolicy: Never state an unrolled base stat, mastery, Size or later acquisition as fact.
contextContract.narrationAuthority: Caption/meme choice does not alter mechanics or tag Shrek funny-results.
contextContract.sourceThemes: Culture, history and franchise version are reference metadata. Only explicit listed effects are granted.
contextContract.referenceEvidence: Keep real-world source category, uncertain tradition, Fate reference/vessel and authored package in separate context layers. Fate appearance does not prove biography or supernatural reality.
